purpose: Maintain the owner-designated historical organizations/projects as evidence candidates without asserting a client relationship, Euroconsult role, result or publication permission until each fact is supported.

classification_contract.public_rule: Only PUBLIC_VERIFIED facts with compatible evidence and publication classification may feed public proof objects.
classification_contract.relationship_rule: Public discoverability of an organization or project does not prove a Euroconsult client, partner, supplier or delivery relationship.
classification_contract.project_rule: Every project must independently prove identity, organization relationship, Euroconsult role, result scope and publicability.
classification_contract.confidentiality_rule: Client/MySMIS records remain outside public output and private by default.
